titles.title: Meat and Poultry Pathogen Reduction and Enforcement Act
Meat and Poultry Pathogen Reduction and Enforcement Act

A bill to protect public health by clarifying the authority of the Secretary of Agriculture to prescribe performance standards for the reduction of pathogens in meat, meat products, poultry, and poultry products processed by establishments receiving inspection services and to enforce the Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Point (HACCP) System requirements, sanitation requirements, and the performance standards.
